block.arcane.arcane_workbench.desc:
A scribe's desk where glyphs become spells.
Glyph order changes the outcome.
block.arcane.mana_crystal.desc:
Pulses with raw mana. Magic grows stronger nearby,
but long exposure is poisonous.
item.arcane.arcane_pen.desc:
Writes the active spell onto blocks and chests.
Ink in the other hand. Sneak to erase.
item.arcane.common_ink.desc: Stable ink with no side effects.
item.arcane.blood_ink.desc:
Lowers the spell's mana cost,
but drains the writer's health.
item.arcane.invisible_ink.desc:
Inscriptions other mages
struggle to see.
item.arcane.arcane_mask.desc:
Filters mana from the air.
Reduces Mana Poisoning by 30%.
item.arcane.insulating_cloak.desc:
Cloth that does not conduct mana.
Reduces Mana Poisoning by 40%.
gui.arcane.cast.tooltip: Casts the active spell with workbench precision.
gui.arcane.name: Spell name
gui.arcane.no_glyphs: You don't know any glyphs yet.
gui.arcane.compose_hint: Click glyphs on the left to compose. Start with a Form.
gui.arcane.glyph_unknown_hint: Not identified yet. Use it in compositions to learn.
message.arcane.inscription.missing_form: A Form is required at the start
message.arcane.inscription.form_not_firs: The Form must be the first glyph
message.arcane.inscription.unknown_knowl: You haven't identified one of these glyphs yet
message.arcane.pen.need_ink: Hold ink in your other hand to write
message.arcane.pen.written.on_open: Inscription written: triggers when the chest is opened
message.arcane.pen.written.on_touch: Inscription written: triggers when stepped on
glyph.arcane.self.desc: Form: the spell happens on you.
glyph.arcane.touch.desc: Form: affects whatever you aim at, up close (3 blocks).
glyph.arcane.projectile.desc: Form: fires an orb that applies the spell where it lands (creature or block).
glyph.arcane.ray.desc: Form: an instant beam that hits the first creature or block you aim at.
glyph.arcane.aura.desc: Form: affects every creature around you (except you).
glyph.arcane.damage.desc: Effect: hurts the target. The creature will turn on you.
glyph.arcane.fire.desc: Effect: sets creatures ablaze. Does nothing to blocks (use Ignite).
glyph.arcane.push.desc: Effect: knocks the target away from you. On yourself, it is a forward dash.
glyph.arcane.slow.desc: Effect: the target moves slowly for a while.
glyph.arcane.poison.desc: Effect: poisons the target, wearing it down (never kills).
glyph.arcane.speed.desc: Effect: the target runs faster for a while.
glyph.arcane.levitate.desc: Effect: the target floats upward for a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.shield.desc: Effect: grants absorption hearts to the target.
glyph.arcane.thunder.desc: Effect: a lightning bolt strikes the target. Beware of the fire.
glyph.arcane.explode.desc: Effect: explodes at the target without breaking blocks. Hurts everyone nearby, you included.
glyph.arcane.blink.desc: Effect: you teleport to the spot you are aiming at.
glyph.arcane.ignite.desc: Effect: lights a fire on the target block, if there is free space above.
glyph.arcane.dig.desc: Effect: breaks the target block if it is soft (dirt, sand, wood, plain stone). Never breaks chests.
glyph.arcane.self_filter.desc: Filter: restricts the effect to you.
glyph.arcane.blocks.desc: Filter: targets blocks instead of creatures.
glyph.arcane.undead.desc: Filter: only affects the undead (zombies, skeletons...).
glyph.arcane.not_self.desc: Filter: removes you from the targets.
glyph.arcane.nearest.desc: Filter: only the creature closest to you.
glyph.arcane.wounded.desc: Filter: only creatures below half health.
glyph.arcane.area.desc: Modifier: doubles the radius of the form and effect (Aura, Explosion).
glyph.arcane.more_range.desc: Modifier: increases the form's range by 50% (Touch, Ray, Blink).
glyph.arcane.delay.desc: Modifier: what follows only happens a few seconds later.
glyph.arcane.power.desc: Modifier: +50% strength on the previous effect (damage, heal, push, level).
glyph.arcane.lengthen.desc: Modifier: doubles the previous effect's time (fire, slow, poison...).
glyph.arcane.on_hit_entity.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a creature is hit.
glyph.arcane.on_hit_block.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a block is hit.
glyph.arcane.after_seconds.desc: Condition: what follows only happens after a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.low_health.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if you are below half health.
glyph.arcane.sneaking.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are sneaking.
glyph.arcane.night.desc: Condition: what follows only happens at night.
glyph.arcane.in_water.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are in water.
glyph.arcane.activate.desc: Activator: triggers a stored ritual (rituals are not available yet).
item.arcane.grimoire.desc:
Your spells, glyphs and discoveries.
Right-click or press G to open.
If the owner dies, only they can take it back.
gui.arcane.grimoire.empty_spells: No saved spells. Build one at the Arcane Workbench.
gui.arcane.grimoire.pick_spell: Pick a spell from the list.
gui.arcane.grimoire.empty_journal: Nothing discovered yet. Watch mages cast, study glyph notes and experiment at the workbench.
gui.arcane.edit.tooltip: Loads the active spell for editing. Saving with the same name replaces it.
gui.arcane.save.tooltip: Saves to the grimoire. The same name as an existing spell replaces it.
